content.title: Happy April Fools Day! Food deals, freebies, discounts today
content.text: April 1, 2026, 1:05 a.m. ETHappy April Fools Day! Pranks and jokes aside, there are plenty of April Fools deals, freebies and discounts today, Wednesday, April 1, so get ready to grab a free Dunkin' coffee or a spring treat with food deals today at Dairy Queen, Olive Garden, Chipotle, The Cheesecake Factory and more.April Fools' Day deals 2026 are coming in hot today with another Dunkin' April Fools free coffee deal rolling out this year — and it's still not a joke with Dunkin free coffee to 1,000,0001 people this year, up from a million free coffees last year.Here's when and how to put in your Dunkin April Fools code, and what other April Fools food deals are available today, including free ice cream, pizza, cheesecake, free burritos and meals at Subway, Domino's, QDOBA, Hooters, Burger King and more. And we promise, this is not a joke. We repeat: April Fools' Day food deals and freebies below.Dunkin' April Fools; Dunkin free coffeeTo get Dunkin' free coffee on April Fools Day today, log into to the Dunkin' app and use the promo code STILLNOTAJOKE to redeem a free coffee. Not a Dunkin' Rewards member? Sign up here.Be sure to make your Dunkin' run this morning, since there are only — not a joke — 1,000,0001 hot or iced coffees given out today. In 2025, Dunkin' offered 1 million free coffees on April Fools, but this year, decided to up the game. Dunkin' Cold Brew and Dunkin' Extra Large Hot Coffee are not included.April Fools deals 2026Ready for some April Fools Day deals? In addition to Dunkin' free coffee today, April 1, here's April Fools food deals, freebies and discounts today. Many chains participate in April Fools Day by offering BOGO deals or free items. Some items listed below are from news releases or reputable bloggers, like The Freebie Guy. Check your location for eligibility.Subway: On April 1, Subway has a BOGO deal, with a free footlong sandwich with the purchase of another, valid through April 28. Sub Club members can use the Subway app or website and input the code FLBOBO.Chipotle: You can win BOGO codes every hour on April 1, according to The Freebie Guy, ahead of National Burrito Day and Chipotle's Burrito Vault, launching April 2.Domino's: Get any pizza with up to 7 toppings (6 for Pan and NY Style) for $9.99 each, through April 6.Dairy Queen: Buy one, get one Blizzard Treat for 99 cents through April 26, at participating DQ locations. DQ Rewards members must use the DQ Mobile App.Olive Garden: Buy One, Take One meal deal at Olive Garden. Choose an entree, soup or salad, and breadsticks, and get your second entree to take home for later. Meals start at $14.99.The Cheesecake Factory: On April Fools Day, customers get a free slice of cheesecake at Cheesecake Factory when they download the new Cheesecake Factory Rewards app and log into their account. The app is available on the App store (iPhone) and Google Play (Samsung).Qdoba: Coinciding with the April 1 full moon (and ahead of National Burrito Day, April 2) Qdoba is offering its signature 3-Cheese Queso or Queso Diablo Chips for free with a purchase of an entree to rewards members. Place your order on the Qdoba website or Qdoba mobile app. Free queso is also available on the next Full Moons: May 1, May 31, June 29, July 29, Aug. 29, Sept. 26, Oct. 26, Nov. 24 and Dec. 23.Burger King: While not technically an April Fools food deal, it's $3.99 Whopper Wednesday at Burger King today.More April Fools food dealsAccording to DealSeek, it's possible Auntie Anne's, Wendy's, 7-Eleven, and Taco Bell may offer April Fools Deals, as each has done so in the past. Here's other confirmed additional April Fools Day food deals 2026 today:BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse: This is no joke: BJ's is offering a Sweet Heat Pepperoni Pizookie for dine-in orders on April 1. The sweet and savory treat is a mix of BJ's Pizookie and its deep-dish pizza and costs just — you guessed it — $4.01.Checkers & Rally's: Customers can get a Big Buford Burger for $3 on April 1 and April 2.Panda Express: For April Fools Day, Panda Express is offering all-new milk dispensers, replacing their soda fountains — which are a joke. However, customers can get one free bottle of milk with every in-restaurant purchase of Dynamite Sweet & Sour Chicken, starting April 2 and while supplies last.Hooter's: April Fools' Day is also Hooter's anniversary, first established on April 1, 1983. It's a big day for the chain. This year on April 1, Hooter's is offering 10 wings for $3.99.Margaritas Mexican Restaurant: Rewards members can save 50% off any burrito on April 1 and April 2, National Burrito Day.Baskin-Robbins: Buy one, get one 50% deal on pre-packaged quarts on April 2 for rewards members at participating locationsDenny's: Free delivery from April 1 through April 2 with a minimum purchase of $5.Shipley Donuts: Free four-pack of kolaches for loyalty members on April 1Marco's Pizza: Customers can use code GOTCHA to receive a Pepperoni Magnifico Pizza for $12.99Sullivan's Steakhouse: $5 off select cocktails and $8 select wines from 3-6 p.m. local time on April 1Yasso: On April 1, Yasso is launching a "Foolproof Freezer" campaign and giving away 40,001 free Yasso Spoonables. Head to the brand's website for a chance to win.Krispy Kreme moon mission doughnut; Krispy Kreme Artemis IIThough not an April Fools Day deal, Krispy Kreme's Artemis II moon mission doughnut has arrived to celebrate NASA's rocket launch of Artemis II, which is expected to launch as soon as today, April 1, per NASA's Artemis II launch countdown. The new Krispy Kreme doughnut is dipped in blue vanilla icing and sprinkled with Oreo crunch and white nonpareils, topped with a swirl of cookies-and-creme-flavored buttercream icing, and a red chevron swirl, a nod to the NASA logo. Is there a Krispy Kreme near me? Head to KrispyKreme.com to find a location near you.
